purpose: Teach: タックル/浪人/飛鳥/ピカソ/ボンド/リンカーン/フットサル/ヤクルト

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがラグビーのタックルを教えて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father says he'll teach you rugby tackles.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact announcement. Light smile in the voice. Sharing good news without making a fuss of it. Slight lift on his name — attentive, not theatrical.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと浪人生のお話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom, I talked with Dad about ronin students.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Quick tempo. Slight breathlessness — proud to report something he learned. Natural child enthusiasm, not performed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが飛鳥の遺跡に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father says he'll take you to the Asuka ruins.
lines.style: Gentle, thoughtful delivery. Slower pace than before. Lingers slightly on the activity — savoring it. The tone of someone noticing something tender happening.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとピカソの本見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I looked at a Picasso book with Dad.
lines.style: Bright report, genuine delight. Quick, clear. Slight pause after 'Dad' — letting the moment land. The small pride of having done something grown-up.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがボンドの新作を観てらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's been watching the new Bond film.
lines.style: Casual observation, faintly amused. Conversational rhythm. Slight warmth — noticing what he's doing, not commenting. The tone of someone who sees and accepts his interests gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとリンカーンのドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to watch the Yakult game with Dad.
lines.style: Eager, direct request. Open, hopeful quality. Slight lift at the end — not demanding, asking. Child's natural enthusiasm, unguarded.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがフットサルの大会に出られるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father says he'll compete in the futsal tournament.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly amused delivery. Warm but measured. Noticing something — her awareness that his life is full, that he's doing things. Tender without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとヤクルトの試合観たいよ
lines.en: Mom, I really want to watch the Yakult game with Dad.
lines.style: Eager, slightly more insistent than before. Open, hopeful quality — wanting something and unafraid to ask. Genuine child emotion, trailing slightly upward on the request.
